skills.name: Piercing Strike
skills.description:
Fredrinn thrusts his sword in the target direction, dealing 125<font color='#47BE34'>( +7% Total HP)</font> <font color='#D58E1F'>(+120% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> to enemies hit and slowing them by 30% for 2s. His next Basic Attack gains extra attack range and deals 85<font color='#D58E1F'>( +100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font>.
This skill deals 150% damage to non-hero enemies.
skills.tips: Use this skill to deal damage and clear lanes, while gaining combo points!

skills.name: Brave Assault
skills.description: Fredrinn dashes in the target direction, dealing 140<font color='#D58E1F'>( +80% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> to the first non-minion enemy hit. His next Basic Attack knocks the target airborne for 0.3s.
skills.tips: Use this skill to approach enemies or start combos. Cast it followed by enhanced Basic Attacks to control enemies.

skills.name: Energy Eruption
skills.description:
Fredrinn deals 210<font color='#D58E1F'>( +100% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> to nearby enemies and taunts them for 1s. Hitting a non-minion enemy grants Fredrinn 15 Physical & Magic Defense for 3s and reduces the cooldowns of <font color='#404495'>(Piercing Strike)</font> and <font color='#404495'>(Brave Assault)</font> by 75%.
This skill costs 1 <font color='#404495'>(Combo Point)</font>.
skills.tips: As the primary damage source, this skill can deal massive damage to enemies in teamfights.

skills.name: Crystalline Armor
skills.description:
Fredrinn gains 1 <font color='#404495'>(Combo Point)</font> that lasts 5s each time his skill hits a non-minion enemy, up to 4 <font color='#404495'>(Combo Points)</font>. His Ultimates cost different numbers of <font color='#404495'>(Combo Points)</font>.
Fredrinn stores 100% of the damage he receives as <font color='#404495'>(Crystal Energy)</font>, which decays after 5s at a rate of 10% Max HP per second.
Fredrinn can convert the stored <font color='#404495'>(Crystal Energy)</font> into HP by 20% of his damage dealt (10% for damage dealt to minions). Gaining a <font color='#404495'>(Combo Point)</font> resets the decaying timer.
skills.tips: He can also restore HP by his damage dealt.

items.name: Warrior Boots
items.des: Unique Passive - Valor: Gain 4 extra Physical Defense for 3s when taking Physical Damage, up to 20.

items.name: Cursed Helmet
items.des: Unique Passive - Burning Soul: Deals Magic Damage equal to 0.6% of the hero's Max HP per second to nearby enemies. This damage is increased by 140% to 350% against creeps and minions (scales with level).

items.name: Thunder Belt
items.des: Unique Passive - Thunderbolt: After casting a skill, the next Basic Attack within 3s deals 50 plus 5% of the hero's extra HP as extra True Damage to the target and enemies around them and slows them by 40%-80% (scales with the hero's extra HP) for 1s (1.5s cooldown).

items.name: Oracle
items.des: Unique Passive - Bless: Received Shield and HP Regen effects are increased by 30%.

items.name: Guardian Helmet
items.des: Unique Passive - Recovery: Regenerates 2.5% Max HP per second (reduced to 0.5% Max HP per second over 5s after taking damage).

builds.tips: For equipment, we recommend this build as it enhances Fredrinn's defense and helps restore HP.

synergy.name: Angela
synergy.tips: Fredrinn works best with support heroes, who can further improve his survivability, like Angela and Floryn.

counters.name: Valir
counters.tips: Fredrinn is strong against Mage heroes who rely on skill bursts, as it is difficult for them to one-shot him with their bursts. Instead, once Fredrinn has enough Combo Points, he can use his 2nd Ultimate to easily finish them off. Such as Vale and Eudora.

countered_by.name: Gloo
countered_by.tips: Highly vulnerable to Gloo's gap closers, target locks, and early game burst potential.
